verdict.rationale: Jan is a local AI chat app whose agents can read the user's files and work on tasks autonomously, so the AI can produce insights and suggestions from user data inside the product. The evidence never describes a dedicated data-analysis or proactive-insights feature, so the story's 'insights from my data' is only implied by general file-reading agent capability. Missing for 10: documented data-analysis or insight-generation workflow, proactive suggestions surfaced from user data, document/data ingestion details (e.g., RAG over files), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Give Jan a task and it works on it autonomously — files, commands, and web research.
Autonomous AI agents that run on your hardware — read files, manage calendars, and take actions via WhatsApp, Discord, or Slack.
